details: Forum report (Chromebook/Chrome): AR-5RM works but two UV-5R8W radios fail with 'expected 1 bytes, received 0' under both the UV-5R and UV-5R8W (BF-F8HP) profiles. The web identity loop tried the next magic immediately; CHIRP waits 2 s after a failed magic, and the BF-F8HP magic is tried second.
external_ref: newchirp.net forum: Web programmer from Chromebook/Chrome works for AR-5RM but not UV-5R8W
summary: Web Programmer read times out on UV-5R8W (BF-F8HP magic)
